app.title: Quarterdeck {version}
today.prioritiesHint: What needs you on your highest-ranked work.
priorities.title: Priorities
priorities.hint: Everything in play, most important first. Drag to reorder. Today shows what needs you on the work at the top of this list, and your agent works from the top down.
priorities.oldest: The oldest started work has been open {age}.
priorities.filter.label: Whose turn
agent.working: Your agent has {n} things on its turn
agent.workingOne: Your agent has 1 thing on its turn
agent.idle: Nothing is your agent's turn right now
deleteSchedule.title: Delete this schedule?
deleteSchedule.body: “{name}” will stop running and its file, schedules/{id}.md, will be removed. This can't be undone.
agent.problems: Some schedule files couldn't be read:
newSchedule.title: New schedule
newSchedule.hint: Tell Claude what to do and when. It works out the timing, machine and permissions.
newSchedule.placeholder: e.g. Every weekday at 8:30, check my PRs for new review comments and reply the way we did yesterday. Ask me about anything that needs a product decision.
newSchedule.example1: Remind me to do timesheets every Friday at 4
newSchedule.example2: Watch CI on my PRs and re-run flaky jobs
newSchedule.example3: Each morning, list Slack threads waiting on me
event.github.ci_failed: Whenever CI fails on one of my PRs
event.github.ci_passed: Whenever CI passes on one of my PRs
event.github.pr_new_comments: Whenever one of my PRs gets new review comments
event.github.pr_behind: Whenever one of my PRs falls behind its base branch
event.github.pr_conflicts: Whenever one of my PRs starts conflicting with its base branch
event.meeting.starting: Whenever a meeting is about to start
event.file.changed: Whenever a file or folder changes
event.custom: A custom event (sent by an agent or script)
schedule.name: Name
schedule.eventHint: Detected by the app, so it costs nothing until it happens.
schedule.cronInvalid: That isn't a valid cron expression yet.
schedule.newFile: Saved as a file Claude can edit later.
schedule.cooldown: Minutes between runs on the same thing
events.title: Recent events
script.hint: Costs no tokens. $QD_EVENT, $QD_SUBJECT and $QD_EVENT_FIELDS say what started it; "$QUARTERDECK" tool <name> '<json>' runs any Quarterdeck tool. Its last line of output is its summary.
script.approvalNeeded: This script was made or changed outside this window, so it won't run until you've checked it.
chat.title: Ask Claude
chat.looking: Looking at {page}. I can make changes too.
chat.suggest.today.1: What should I sort out before my next meeting?
chat.suggest.priorities.1: What can I unblock in 10 minutes?
chat.suggest.priorities.2: Suggest an order for the rest of the week
chat.suggest.board.1: What has been in review longest?
chat.suggest.agent.1: Check my PRs every morning at 08:30
chat.suggest.agent.2: Which schedules could be events instead?
urgent.title: Urgent
urgent.hint: Things that went wrong or can’t wait. Dismiss them, or tell Claude what to do.
urgent.messagePlaceholder: e.g. skip it today, or find who broke it and ask them
pause.title: Pause all schedules
pause.hint: Nothing runs while paused, and missed runs aren’t flagged as urgent. Each schedule keeps its own on/off setting for when you’re back.
pause.bannerIndefinite: Everything is paused until you resume
pause.bannerHint: Nothing runs, and missed runs aren’t flagged as urgent.
area.label: Areas
todo.title: To do
todo.hint: Things only you can do. Claude reminds you, and can help plan them.
todo.empty: Nothing to do here. Add one, or ask Claude: “remind me to book the dentist on Friday”.
item.title: Title
item.label: Where it’s at
item.labelPlaceholder: e.g. waiting on review from Sam
item.confirmDelete: Delete {id} and its history? This can’t be undone.
item.parked: Parked: off Today until the day you chose, or until what it waits for happens. Then it’s your turn again.
tell.label: Tell Claude what to do
tell.placeholder: e.g. merge develop in and fix the conflicts
tell.sent: Sent. Claude picks it up within a minute.
ask.gone: That question was already answered or dismissed. Refreshing…
history.label: “{label}”
empty.board: Nothing here yet. Add an item, or connect GitHub in quarterdeck.toml.
empty.priorities: Nothing in play. Add an item to start ranking.
empty.agent: No schedules yet. Describe one with New schedule.
commitment.title: New meeting or appointment
commitment.calendarHint: Calendar events appear here once a calendar is added on the Agent tab.
connect.title: Connect your Claude sessions
connect.hint: Run this once in a terminal. Every Claude Code session can then read and update Quarterdeck: “add dinner on Friday to my to-dos”, “move JD-104 to review”.
connect.elsewhere: Claude Code is connected to another copy of Quarterdeck. Run this to point it at this one.
connections.title: Connections
calendar.macEmpty: The Calendar app has no calendars yet.
calendar.macHint: Any account in the Calendar app works, including work accounts with no iCal link. Add one in System Settings → Internet Accounts.
calendar.linkHint: In Google Calendar: Settings → your calendar → “Secret address in iCal format”. In Outlook: Settings → Shared calendars → Publish a calendar → ICS link.
item.synced: From {source}. Quarterdeck updates it when it changes there; your edits stick until then.
today.hideHint: Hide {title}. It stays hidden after calendar syncs.
alert.snoozeLabel: Remind me again in a minute
dev.banner: Dev build · its own data and config, apart from the installed app
item.reply: Reply, or tell Claude what to do
park.hint: It leaves Today until then, and comes back as your turn. If nobody will pick it up, delete it or mark it done instead.
park.whyPlaceholder: e.g. waiting for the v2 API
